scripts.check: npm run predeploy:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run check && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,hosting
scripts.audit: npm run predeploy:check && npm run audit:source && npm run typecheck && npm run build
scripts.deploy:homolog: npm run homologate && firebase deploy --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes,hosting
scripts.release:full: npm run deploy:doctor && npm run release:check && npm run release:deploy
scripts.qa: npm run predeploy:check && npm run audit:source && npm run e2e:readiness
scripts.check:all: npm run predeploy:check && npm run audit:source && npm run click:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run functions:typecheck && npm run functions:build
scripts.integration:check: npm run test:click && npm run functions:typecheck && npm run functions:build
scripts.homologation:precheck: npm run predeploy:check && npm run audit:source && npm run test:click && npm run e2e:readiness
scripts.v1:verify: npm run predeploy:check && npm run audit:source && npm run test:click && npm run e2e:readiness
scripts.robot:install: npm --prefix apps/robot install && npx --prefix apps/robot playwright install chromium
